description: This Java source file defines the SSLFactory class used for creating and managing SSL/TLS contexts in Apache Spark, supporting both JDK and Netty SSL implementations, with configuration options for keystores, truststores, protocols, ciphers, and OpenSSL support.

classes.name: SSLFactory
classes.description: Main class for creating SSL contexts and engines with support for JDK and Netty implementations, configurable protocols, ciphers, and trust management.

classes.name: SSLFactory.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing SSLFactory instances with specific SSL/TLS configuration options.

methods.name: createSSLEngine
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SSLEngine for client or server mode with specified protocols and ciphers.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the SSLFactory, including trust managers and SSL contexts.
